welcomeSub: Track what you spend, what you earn, and stay inside your monthly limit — all on your device.
currencySub: This is how amounts will be shown across the app.
cycleSub: Choose how your month is tracked and how much you want to spend.
calendarMonthSub: Resets on the 1st of every month
customCycleSub: Resets on a day you choose — e.g. salary day
notifSub: We can remind you if you go quiet, and warn you before you hit your limit. You can change this anytime in Settings.
